prompt: One of the signed-in user's exhibitions as a cover card: the opening work framed on a mat in front of two offset gilt frames, then the title, subtitle and a 'n works · updated …' line, linking to the exhibition page.
shortDesc: One of the user's exhibitions as a cover card: the first work framed on a mat, then the title, subtitle and 'n works · updated …', linking to /exhibitions/<exhibition-id>. g-exhibition-list renders these; don't place it directly. If you ever must, copy fields from a ListExhibitions item: exhibition-id="x7Qp2", title and subtitle exactly as returned (already escaped), artwork-count="9", image-url = coverImageUrl (starts with /__art/; omit when null), updated-at = updatedAt (ISO, e.g. "2026-09-20T10:00:00Z"). Never pass a generated /images/ URL: it is ignored.

props.name: exhibition-id
props.description: Exhibition id from ListExhibitions, e.g. x7Qp2. The card links to /exhibitions/<exhibition-id>; without it the card is shown unlinked.

props.name: title
props.description: Exhibition title, passed exactly as the tool returned it (already escaped; decoded once and re-escaped). Newsreader 22px, clamped to 2 lines. Moved off the host on connect so it never shows as a native tooltip.

props.name: artwork-count
props.description: Number of works, e.g. 9. Shown as '9 works'; 0 shows the dashed 'No works yet' frame.

props.name: image-url
props.description: coverImageUrl (/__art/…); omit when null. Anything not starting with /__art/ is ignored: with artwork-count above 0 the mat then shows the neutral 'Image unavailable' placeholder; the dashed 'No works yet' frame shows only when artwork-count is 0 (or when neither a count nor a cover is given).

props.name: updated-at
props.description: ISO date of the last change, shown relatively: 'updated 3 days ago'.

styling.tailwindClasses: flex flex-col h-full no-underline; hang: relative mt-3 mr-3 with two gilt 1px frames offset 6px and 12px up-right behind; mat: relative grid place-items-center aspect-[4/3] bg-stone-200 rounded-sm overflow-hidden; body: grid gap-1 pt-3.5
styling.notes: VITRINE kit. 4:3 --mat box, cover object-fit: contain with 7% padding and a soft drop-shadow (never cropped), fading in over 250ms; the mat pulses as a skeleton until it loads, and a failed image shows the neutral placeholder (italic title + 'IMAGE UNAVAILABLE'). Two gilt hairline frames sit behind the mat (offset 6px/12px up-right), spreading slightly on hover. Empty exhibitions (artwork-count 0, or no count and no cover): --paper mat with a dashed gilt frame, 'No works yet' in italic serif --soft and a small label. Title Newsreader 500 22px (upright: it is the curator's title, not an artwork), subtitle 15px --soft 2-line clamp, meta 13px tabular --soft with a --rule middot. Hover/focus: 1px gilt inset on the mat, oxblood title underline, -2px lift (static under reduced motion); focus ring 2px oxblood around the mat.

markupSketch:
{title}

{subtitle}

{artwork-count} works · updated 3 days ago
usageExample: <g-exhibition-card exhibition-id="x7Qp2" title="Blue hours" subtitle="Twilight across five centuries" artwork-count="9" image-url="/__art/met/ep/web-large/DT1567.jpg" updated-at="2026-09-20T10:00:00Z"></g-exhibition-card>
